declaration.negotiation_history_statement: I submit this statement on behalf of Hargrove Lane LLP in support of preliminary approval. Counsel exchanged complete settlement proposals over two rounds. Our initial proposal was a $32 million class fund and $7 million in court-approved fees and expenses; Brightline countered with $28 million and $6 million, respectively. We then proposed, and Brightline accepted, a $30 million class fund and $5 million in fees and expenses, subject to court approval. Class relief and fees were discussed together throughout; I do not represent that fees were negotiated only after class relief was agreed. The settlement provides automatic payments to identified class members, without a claim form. Brightline will not oppose the fee request, and any fees the Court declines to award will go to the class rather than revert to Brightline. The clear-sailing provision and fee arrangement warrant the Court’s independent scrutiny. The $30 million fund represents approximately 47% of the $64 million in disputed charges and provides certain, prompt relief against certification risk and the risks and delay of litigation. Based on those considerations and the direct distribution, I believe the proposed settlement is fair, reasonable, and adequate to the class, subject to the Court’s review. I make no representation here that the fee amount itself has been approved.
